title: Ordinary etale compact-support adjunction and projection over arbitrary bases
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-pc-scheme] supplied with a factorization $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}Y$, where $j$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $r$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $rj=f$. No quasi-compactness condition is imposed on $j$. On the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact extension by zero $Dj_!$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] and total right-derived direct image $Rr_*$, put $F_f=Rr_*Dj_!$. Then $F_f$ has a right adjoint $G_f$ with counit $\epsilon_f:F_fG_f\to\mathrm{id}$. For every $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the canonical compactification projection map is an isomorphism
$$F_fM\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}F_f(M\otimes_A^Lf^*K).$$
Here $f^*=f^{-1}$ is exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and tensor is [def-kun-derived-tensor]. The map is the proper counit-defined projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] followed by the open-extension tensor comparison. In particular, for $\omega_f=G_fA_Y$, the transpose of
$$F_f(\omega_f\otimes_A^Lf^*K)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}^{-1}}F_f\omega_f\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\epsilon_{f,A_Y}\otimes1}A_Y\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}K$$
defines a morphism $\theta_{f,K}:\omega_f\otimes_A^Lf^*K\to G_fK$ for every unbounded $K$.

source.place: Paragraph 1, adjunction and compactification projection; arbitrary-base formulation checked against upstream LowerShriekLeftAdjoint.lean, isLeftAdjoint_rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification, lines 207-222, and ProjectionFormula.lean, isIso_projectionMap_of_finite, lines 291-303. The generalization is agent-stated; the blueprint paragraph alone has a Noetherian standing base.

proof.text: Exact extension by zero and exact inverse image induce the unbounded derived adjunction D(j_!) ⊣ D(j^*), implemented by derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction. It is the termwise derived adjunction of the sheaf adjunction. Its left functor is therefore a left adjoint; no quasi-compactness of j is needed.

Apply isLeftAdjoint_proper_rightDerivedLowerStar to the proper factor c.g and the finite coefficient ring A, using lem-etale-proper-derived-direct-image-adjoint. The supplied-compactification functor is definitionally D(c.i_!) ⋙ R(c.g_*). Composition of the two left adjoints gives its right-adjoint existence on the entire ordinary unbounded derived category. This uses the existing proper-factor Brown argument rather than repeating its coproduct proof here.

For arbitrary M and K, isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite A c.g makes the proper projection map invertible. Rewrite the canonical supplied-compactification map using projectionMapOfCompactification_app_app: it is this proper projection component followed by R(c.g_*) of the inverse open projection isomorphism, then by the mapped tensor of the inverse-image composition isomorphism. Functors preserve isomorphisms, so the composite is invertible. This proves invertibility of the specified canonical map, rather than merely existence of an isomorphism of its endpoints.

For any selected right adjoint G and adjunction, specialize the preceding projection isomorphism to M = G(A_Y), invert it, compose with the counit at A_Y tensored with K and the derived left unitor, then transpose with adj.homEquiv. This is exactly the existing definition sfEtaleAmbientTensorMap. Neither an arbitrary comparison nor invertibility of that transpose is asserted.

The tensor transpose definition is unchanged.

Step 7 meets the hypotheses of lem-coproducts-of-copowers, and step 8 those of Brown 0F5Y (injectives.tex:2804). Step 9's θ is the transpose stated in the item, matching thm-asd-smooth-tensor.proof.md paragraph 1 (main-20261015).
